findings.title: Interpolating before querySupportsSplitting breaks $__range detection and doubly applies adhoc filters
findings.body:
In `runSplitQuery`, `datasource.applyTemplateVariables(query, request.scopedVars, request.filters)` is now called before `querySupportsSplitting` and before `datasource.runQuery` (or `runSplitQuery` when invoked from `shardQuerySplitting.ts`). This causes two issues:

1. `querySupportsSplitting` checks `!isQueryWithRangeVariable(query.expr)` so that queries containing `$__range`, `$__range_s`, or `$__range_ms` are not split (since `$__range` is supposed to represent the full query range rather than each split chunk). However, if `applyTemplateVariables` (or a custom template variable) replaces `$__range` or if `runShardSplitQuery` interpolates the query and then calls `runSplitQuery` which calls `applyTemplateVariables(query, request.scopedVars, request.filters)` a second time (And then `datasource.runQuery` / `super.query` calls `applyTemplateVariables` a third time), `request.filters` (adhoc filters) will be injected into `query.expr` multiple times if `request.filters` is non-empty, duplicating stream selector matchers on every pass.
